role: The redstone dust item (id 331): places redstone_wire on the clicked cell (with the plain six-side shift and a snow-layer special case).

members.name: onItemUse
members.note: the six-side shift, the snow-layer cell reuse, the canPlaceBlockAt check and the setBlock; with redstone = off the wire never carries power, which the native handles by never running power updates

notes: Placement is in scope and ported; power propagation is the world switch, owned by the block side, not this item.
